limitations: Historical capture replay is not new live NPU collection.
Repeated variants reuse eight captures and cannot multiply independent coverage.
All fifteen current model declarations are partial; operator acceptance is not full-model validation.
A3 invocation constraints are user-reported declarations, not new independent calibration.
GLM selected MSD hardware has explicit devices without invocation parameters; A3 defaults do not apply there.
A5 has no inferred general kernel-class completion default.
Completion constraints change timing only; physical work/service remain the same.
Reference programs and missing native boundaries are not eligible accuracy evidence.
Elapsed time and current source hashes belong to the new full replay, not the old accuracy refresh.
